title: Add full-screen pane layout model and narrow terminal fallback
purpose: Introduce a stable full-screen TUI layout that can run as the main operator shell.
scope: Define pane layout model for status bar, navigation rail, run workspace, event feed and command palette area.
Define narrow terminal fallback with a single focused panel and tab strip.
Keep dimensions stable to prevent layout jumps.
Reuse existing line renderers as initial panel content.
acceptance_criteria: Wide and narrow layouts render deterministically.
All text fits within panel boundaries.
Existing scripted output remains available for automation.
Layout does not require GUI or web UI.
failure_modes: Narrow terminal output overlaps or truncates unsafe context.
Layout code duplicates runtime projection logic.
